name: Current Month Expiry
description: This keyword can be used in condition builder as well as in expiry FX of the position builder
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the current month expiry date of the instrument as a string in the format  YYYY-MM-DD

This keyword can be used in condition builder as well as in expiry FX of the position builder

![Example](./images/img-1631877274.png)

The above example can be used in condition builder to check if the current day is the monthly expiry

![Example](./images/img-1631877356.png)

The above condition can be used in the expiry FX of the position builder to trade next month expiry
